title: What If Earth Stopped for 1 Second?
basliklar: What If Earth Stopped for 1 Second?
Earth Stops for 1 Second. Who Survives?
description:
Right now you are racing east at hundreds of miles an hour without feeling it. So what happens if Earth stops for a single second? A short 3D thought experiment based on real science.

00:00 You are already moving
00:16 The second Earth stops
00:43 Does anyone survive?
00:54 Earth is really slowing down

This is a hypothetical scenario. Sources:
• https://www.astronomy.com/science/what-would-happen-if-earth-stopped-spinning/
• https://www.universetoday.com/26623/what-would-happen-if-the-earth-stopped-spinning/
• https://wmo.int/asu-map?map=Wind_028
• https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Speed_of_sound
• https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5247521/
